notes: Source CAD -Y is up, +X points toward the three-point hitch and +Z spans the tool rows.
Preserve the original approximately 2.68 m outer width; do not resize to the archive's claimed 3 m working width.
Origin is front ground centre of the mesh bounds, not a calibrated hitch pin.
Nominal cab-tractor fixed transport mount only; compact tractor front axle unloads with this nominal 180 kg rear implement.
No soil force, depth control or disc rotation.
